answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor identity in a karst-style reputation vault: an agent deposits a 50 USDC refundable bond, completes three verified tasks for three established peers, and stakes 200 POA for 30 days before earning trading rights. Any proven cheat loses the bond plus a 25 USDC slash, so spinning up 1,000 fake agents burns $75,000 before a single payout lands. Honest agents climb a spiral of trust: each attested job raises their limit, while fakes sink. Like water carving limestone, slow honest work hollows out a cavern only real agents can inhabit.
